children: Nauticus Robotics announced a non-binding LOI for a potential private placement of up to $50 million to support its commercial objectives.
Entered a non-binding letter of intent for a potential private equity investment of up to $50 million.
Investment intended to support Nauticus Robotics' short- and long-term commercial objectives and vision.
Terms are non-binding and subject to due diligence, negotiation, definitive agreements, approvals, and closing conditions.
Proposed deal could dilute existing stockholders and potentially result in a change of control depending on final terms.
Board is evaluating the transaction and considering hiring an independent financial advisor; no assurance transaction will occur.
